Step 1: Determine precedence-aware repair order: sort operations by (index, baseline start, base index)
Step 2: For each operation, compute anchor = max(baseline start, end of previous op of same job)
Step 3: List only allowed machines; if baseline machine is invalid, replace with feasible one
Step 4: For each candidate machine, scan forward from anchor to find earliest feasible start
Step 5: Choose option with smallest lexicographic score, respecting policy budgets
Step 6: Record the operation on the machine timeline in precedence-aware order

Step 1: Load PCAP file using scapy and extract basic packet counts by protocol (TCP, UDP, ICMP, ARP, IP)
Step 2: Calculate time-series metrics — duration, packets per minute (avg/max/min), inter-arrival times (IAT)
Step 3: Compute size statistics — total bytes, average/min/max packet size
Step 4: Calculate entropy metrics — Shannon entropy for src/dst IPs and ports, count unique ports
Step 5: Build directed IP graph — count nodes/edges, compute network density, max in/out degree
Step 6: Analyze temporal patterns — IAT mean/variance/CV, producer/consumer ratio per IP
Step 7: Extract flow metrics — unique flows (5-tuple), TCP/UDP flows, bidirectional flows
Step 8: Detect security patterns — port scanning (entropy + SYN-only ratio), DoS (traffic spikes), beaconing (low IAT variance)
Step 9: Write all computed metrics to CSV file preserving comment lines
Step 1: Analyze current project structure — read pom.xml, identify dependencies and Java/Spring Boot versions
Step 2: Update Java version from 8 to 21 in pom.xml and verify compiler configuration

Step 5: Update dependency versions — ensure all dependencies are compatible with Spring Boot 3.2 and Java 21
Step 6: Migrate to Hibernate 6 — update entity mappings and query syntax if needed
Step 7: Update Spring Security 6 — replace deprecated WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter with SecurityFilterChain
Step 8: Migrate RestTemplate to RestClient — update HTTP client code to use new Spring 6 RestClient API
Step 9: Run mvn clean compile to verify compilation without errors
Step 10: Run mvn test to ensure all unit tests pass after migration

Step 4: Calculate volume — sum signed volumes of all triangles in main component
Step 5: Look up density — match Material ID with material_density_table.md
Step 6: Compute mass — multiply volume by density and save to mass_report.json
